title: CN/V20261019 explicit battle predicates
$comment: CN-advanced-3.1.0 SHA256 27bda43d8cb78ed800891c6793e5efd945ac64d94a83ceff8adaed10e8f67419: II.A PDF p19, II.B-01..03 p19–20, II.D-15..17 p50–51 (one-based). Actual conditions require the reviewed card binding's sourceOfTruth; this syntax is not card approval. Values use exact integer arithmetic, not coercion. Validate the full static AST before short-circuiting runtime logic; unresolved facts must not become false/zero. The host supplies plain normalized facts; missing/getter holders are not explicit null.

compare.description: Compare two exact signed integers. No final damage clamp or safe-Number conversion is applied to intermediate Values.

exists.description: Only an explicit null holder is absent. Missing, inherited, hidden, accessor or non-record holders are invalid facts, never false.

pokemonIs.description: Whether one holder matches a Pokémon selector (current types) and/or an in-play state. A missing holder is an invalid fact, never false.

stadiumInPlay.description: Whether a Stadium is in play, put into play by the effect user (own), the opponent, or anyone (any), optionally matching a Trainer selector.

historyFact.description: Battle-history facts of the effect user, judged on the user's own turn: previousOpponentKnockout (II.E-11, one of the user's Pokémon was Knocked Out during the previous opponent turn; cause attackDamage = by attack damage), movedToActive (II.E-24, this Pokémon moved from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn), supporterPlayed (II.E-25, the user played a Supporter from hand this turn, optionally matching a selector), healed (II.E-26, this Pokémon's HP was healed this turn).
